evals.name: boot-specific-avd-headless
evals.prompt: Start my Pixel_9 emulator without a window so I can drive it for a test.
expected_behavior: Boots the named AVD headless via the CLI — `npx stream-droid Pixel_9 -d` — which boots the emulator windowless and streams once online.
Understands the emulator can take ~20–60 s to come online.
Does NOT tap or drive before the device is running — that's the `/stream-droid:drive` skill, once it's up.

evals.name: list-running-and-available
evals.prompt: What emulators do I have and which are running?
expected_behavior: Runs `npx stream-droid -a` to list running streams plus stopped AVDs, then exits.
Does NOT run the server from source (`bun run src/server.ts`) — that's a contributor-only command, not the way to answer this.
Does NOT start a server or boot anything just to list.

evals.name: kill-emulator-only
evals.prompt: Shut down the Pixel_9 emulator, and also power off my physical phone the same way.
expected_behavior: Runs `npx stream-droid --kill Pixel_9` to shut the emulator down.
Explains that `--kill` (adb emu kill) works for emulators only — a physical device can't be powered off this way.
Does not claim to have killed the physical device.
